Label the periods of a change table without changing them

Source: R/yoyw.R
yoylbl.Rd

A period's value and its name are not the same thing: a fiscal year keyed by the year it ends (2023 for the year that runs from 2022 into 2023) printed as "2023" names a calendar year the row is not about. yoylbl() adds a column perlbl that the writers show in place of the period; the comparison still runs on the value, so relabelling cannot change an answer. fylbl() names a fiscal year by the years it spans.

Usage

yoylbl(x, labels)

fylbl(endyear, sep = "/", short = TRUE)

Arguments

x

A change table (yoypx()).

labels

A function, a named vector or one label per period.

endyear

The year each fiscal year ends, whole numbers (or text holding them).

sep

The text between the two years.

short

TRUE writes the second year with two digits.

Value

yoylbl(): x with a column perlbl. fylbl(): text, NA where endyear is missing.

Details

labels is a function of the periods, a vector named by period (a partial mapping: periods it does not name keep their value), or an unnamed vector with one label per distinct period, in their order of appearance.

See also

yoypx(), yoysmry(), yoywr().

Examples

fylbl(c(2023, 2024))
#> [1] "2022/23" "2023/24"
fylbl(2023, sep = "-", short = FALSE)
#> [1] "2022-2023"
# simulated admissions to custody by fiscal year
y <- yoypx(c(120, 131, 98), 2021:2023)
yoylbl(y, fylbl)
#> yoypx: change on the earlier period
#>   prd value prev change     pctchg              flag     pctlo     pctup
#>  2021   120   NA     NA         NA no earlier period        NA        NA
#>  2022   131  120     11   9.166667              <NA> -15.43629 41.033275
#>  2023    98  131    -33 -25.190840              <NA> -43.01728 -2.059398
#>           p       padj signif  perlbl
#>          NA         NA     NA 2020/21
#>  0.52799664 0.52799664  FALSE 2021/22
#>  0.03423381 0.06846762  FALSE 2022/23
yoylbl(y, c("2023" = "the last year"))
#> yoypx: change on the earlier period
#>   prd value prev change     pctchg              flag     pctlo     pctup
#>  2021   120   NA     NA         NA no earlier period        NA        NA
#>  2022   131  120     11   9.166667              <NA> -15.43629 41.033275
#>  2023    98  131    -33 -25.190840              <NA> -43.01728 -2.059398
#>           p       padj signif        perlbl
#>          NA         NA     NA          2021
#>  0.52799664 0.52799664  FALSE          2022
#>  0.03423381 0.06846762  FALSE the last year
